occupations.title: Marketing Managers
occupations.rationale: The product is described as a marketing platform for creating and optimizing campaigns via email, SMS, and WhatsApp to "drive business growth and lasting loyalty" [D:Brevo:landing:1].

occupations.title: Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists
occupations.rationale: These specialists would use the software to "Create high‑converting campaigns effortlessly—generate copy, auto‑segment audiences, optimize send times, and deliver dynamic product recommendations" [D:Brevo:landing:2].

occupations.title: General and Operations Managers
occupations.rationale: The product is explicitly marketed as being "Built for every business...FOR ENTREPRENEURS & SMALL BUSINESSES," roles often held by General and Operations Managers who need simple, powerful tools to start fast [D:Brevo:landing:3].
